A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
PFA, ZDV and DTG salvage therapy is effective in HIV‐1 and HIV‐2 patients failing cART.
PFA–ZVD–DTG is a salvage therapy option for HIV‐2 infected and HIV‐1 infected patients with advanced HIV‐infection, who are failing cART.

a salvage therapy including PFA, ZDV and DTG could be a good option in patients with advanced infection and no other therapeutic options.
